title: rustle benchmark campaign
description: A published measurement campaign: its conditions, which runs make it up, its caveats. Hand-edited; the seed, repeats, proxy cores and auth are checked against the runs.

$schema.title: Schema pointer
$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editors.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this contract. A breaking change bumps it; readers must refuse a version they do not know.

id.title: Campaign id
id.description: Id of the campaign: its folder name under bench/data/ and bench/published/.

rustle_version.title: rustle version
rustle_version.description: Version of rustle that was benchmarked.

commit.title: Commit
commit.description: Commit of rustle that was benchmarked.

origin_sink.title: Origin and sink
origin_sink.description: Runs the static origin and the discard sink.

measured_with.title: Measured with
measured_with.description: Tool used to measure the link.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed of the shuffled test order (checked against the runs).

repeats.title: Repeats
repeats.description: Measured runs per point; the median is kept (checked against the runs).

run_seconds.title: Run length
run_seconds.description: Duration of a measured run in seconds.

proxy_cores.title: Proxy cores
proxy_cores.description: Cores (and workers) given to every proxy in the main matrix (checked against the runs).

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Whether authentication was on (checked against the runs).

noise_pct.title: Noise
noise_pct.description: Run-to-run noise range in percent: differences below it are not conclusions.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: The measurement protocol in one sentence.

fairness.title: Fairness document
fairness.description: Path of the document that records each competitor's version and tuning.

results.title: Results document
results.description: Path of the document with the full tables.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The raw runs the numbers are computed from: the manifest of the campaign. tools/aggregate.py reads them, nothing else.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Every run of the campaign. For a role, a later entry for the same proxy and transport replaces an earlier one.

unsupported.title: Unsupported
unsupported.description: Proxies that cannot do a transport at all (listed as unsupported, never as zero).

plain.title: plain
plain.description: Proxies that cannot do the plain tests.

tls.title: tls
tls.description: Proxies that cannot do the tls tests.

tls-full-handshake.title: tls-full-handshake
tls-full-handshake.description: Proxies that cannot do the tls-full-handshake tests.

h2.title: h2
h2.description: Proxies that cannot do the h2 tests.

ws.title: ws
ws.description: Proxies that cannot do the ws tests.

ws-tls.title: ws-tls
ws-tls.description: Proxies that cannot do the ws-tls tests.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: What the benchmark does not cover, to print next to the numbers.

test_notes.title: Test notes
test_notes.description: Editorial reading of a point, by test id of benchmarks.json (for instance the link ceiling). Open by design: the keys are test ids.

machine.title: Machine
machine.description: One server of the benchmark setup.

run.title: Run
run.description: One run directory (a proxy on one transport) and the part it plays in the campaign.

role.title: Role
role.description: main: the plain, TLS, TLS full-handshake and HTTP/2 matrices. ws: the WebSocket matrix. ktls: rustle with tls.ktls = true. scaling: the multi-core curve (one run per proxy and core count). flood: the tunnel test taken from another campaign (a single host over loopback).

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Proxy of the run (checked against its run.json).

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Transport of the run (checked against its run.json).

cores.title: Cores
cores.description: Cores given to the proxy; scaling runs only.

run.title: Run
run.description: Directory of the run (it holds run.json), relative to bench/; normally the committed copy under published/.

proxyId.title: Proxy id
proxyId.description: Identifier of a compared proxy. A new proxy is added here: an additive change.
